no_preview_declaration: AMENDED SEAL (errata 1, protocol section 0). The first attempt under design commit 63ebafc and seal commit e6869ee stopped with status design_failure during train-block construction at seed 200058, where the universa.budgets discriminability guard refused to build an instance whose decoy shares the true target's kernel. It produced 0 raw rows, trained no model, executed no arm, and computed no claim; it is retained immutably at results/experiments/failures/router-loop-v4-sealed-1.design_failure.json. Its blocks 200001..200400 (train) and 210001..210036 (eval) are VOID for claims and are never reused. The scratch range 500001..500600, used once to measure the generator-collision rate during the errata diagnosis, is burned and must never be declared as a train or eval block. No seed in 230001..230036 (the replacement sealed eval block) or 220001..220400 (the replacement reserved train block, the same 400-seed data budget carried forward unchanged) has ever been instantiated, previewed, counted for eligibility, smoke-tested, or debugged with, on any generator family or in any pipeline stage. A repository-wide word-boundary search of the working tree and all git history before this amended seal found ZERO occurrences of either replacement block outside the protocol, runner, tests, and this seal. Tests instantiate only the sanctioned fixture seeds (70001..70005, 70501..70540, 70601..70620) or hand-built fixtures, and monkeypatch the runner's frozen seed constants to them. The calibration-rule change was motivated solely by the published loop-v2 and loop-v3 mechanisms (docs/24 and docs/27), never by any eval outcome; the equal unit costs are declared a priori from the design's own cost symmetry, not chosen to make any claim pass. The errata-1 train-side build exclusion was chosen from the first attempt's failure mechanism alone, cannot move any claim in any direction, and is fail-closed above 20 exclusions or an empty block. If even one seed of either replacement block is accidentally instantiated in its role before execution, the affected block is void and a new block must be chosen and verified absent.

primary_family.theta: mean over eligible seeds of [condition-mean correctness(arch-full-v4) - condition-mean correctness(generic-mlp)], each a mean of the seed's three condition indicators
primary_family.support_rule: supported iff the one-sided Bonferroni lower bound (alpha = 0.05/4, Student-t critical value for the eligible n) exceeds 0 (the full architecture beats the no-architecture model end to end)

primary_family.theta: mean over eligible seeds of [condition-mean correctness(arch-full-v4) - condition-mean correctness(routing-only)]
primary_family.support_rule: supported iff the one-sided Bonferroni lower bound exceeds 0 (the discovery head's measured contribution; routing-only fails out-of-library by construction)

primary_family.theta: mean over eligible seeds of [correct(arch-full-v4) - correct(generic-mlp)] on the in-library condition
primary_family.support_rule: supported iff the one-sided Bonferroni lower bound exceeds 0 (strict; a tie fails the claim and is reported as frozen). loop-v3's h3 failed at estimate +0.0833 with lower bound -0.1523 on the variance induced by its 14 false alarms; this claim is read against that baseline and may pass or fail.

primary_family.theta: mean over eligible seeds of [correct(arch-full-v4) - correct(discovery-only)] on the in-library condition
primary_family.support_rule: supported iff the one-sided Bonferroni lower bound exceeds -0.05 (bounded harm, not superiority; a pass OR fail is reported frozen, never reinterpreted). loop-v2's h4 failed at -1/36 and loop-v3's at -14/36.

stop_rules: Any preflight mismatch: seal-validation failure (unknown seal key at any level including inside a claim object, descriptive claim subfields missing or blank, tampered claim field, a train_seed_block other than {first: 200001, last: 200400}, an eval_seed_block other than {first: 210001, last: 210036}, design_commit absent from history or not an ancestor of HEAD, the imported universa package not resolving under the project's src), hash mismatch, seal not committed at HEAD, on-disk seal not byte-identical to its HEAD blob, symlinked seal/protocol/runner, dirty worktree, existing output path, available CUDA, or torch thread count other than one.

A worktree found dirty, a code-manifest hash found changed, or the on-disk seal, protocol, or runner file found changed or deleted at the end-of-run publication guard (a classified design_failure with a preserved artifact, never a bare traceback).
A raw-row count violating the frozen invariant 4 arms x 3 conditions x |eligible seeds|.
An EVAL-block instance-build exception: whole-run design_failure, never an exclusion; the offending seed is recorded, the run stops, no seed is ever deleted alone.

A TRAIN-block instance-build exception (errata 1): a recorded, counted EXCLUSION rather than a stop - the seed is not an instance of the family - unless more than MAX_TRAIN_EXCLUDED = 20 seeds are excluded or no seed builds, either of which is a whole-run design_failure. A train-side feature-construction exception, shape violation, or non-finite feature remains a whole-run design_failure.
Fewer than 30 eligible seeds (the build and the undegraded audit): design_failure_insufficient_eligible with no training, no calibration, and no claims.

Any determinism failure (including the double-execution bit-identity check), NaN, audit (other than the per-seed eligibility gate), rank, training, calibration, or validation failure: whole-run design_failure. This includes a calibration record that is not the frozen eight-key shape, whose costs are not the frozen 1.0/1.0, or whose total_cost disagrees with its own rates and costs.
Aggregation failure or a non-finite estimand.
Any manual cancellation or infrastructure interruption: interrupted.
No outcome-dependent stopping, no interim analysis, no sample-size extension, no seed-level deletion.
Never rerun because results are surprising, weak, null, or apparently decisive; any code, tolerance, dependency, or analysis change after a partial run invalidates the seed block.
